data: NVIDIA reported net income of $72,880 million (about $72.9 billion) for fiscal 2025, the year ended January 26, 2025, while Tesla reported net income of $3,855 million (about $3.9 billion) for fiscal 2025, the year ended December 31, 2025. NVIDIA's figure is roughly 18.9 times Tesla's ($72,880 million divided by $3,855 million). If you use Tesla's net income attributable to common stockholders of $3,794 million instead, the multiple is about 19.2 times. Note that the two fiscal years end almost a year apart, so NVIDIA's period largely overlaps calendar 2024.
